PURPOSE OF THE UNIT STANDARD
This unit standard is intended:
 to provide fundamental knowledge of the areas covered?
 for those working in, or entering the workplace in the area of Business and Organisational Communication ?
 as additional knowledge for those wanting to understand the areas covered
People credited with this unit standard are able to:?
 Contribute to team problem solving?
 Contribute to group and/ or team function
The performance of all elements is to a standard that allows for further learning in this area.
LEARNING ASSUMED TO BE IN PLACE AND RECOGNITION OF PRIOR LEARNING
The learner should have the competence to communicate in English (or the applicable language) at least at NQF level 3.
Specific Outcomes and Assessment Criteria:
SPECIFIC OUTCOME 1
Contribute to team problem solving
ASSESSMENT CRITERIA
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 1
1\. Contributions made are relevant to, and focussed on, subject matter and group/ team objectives.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Ideas; Information; Opinions; Recommendations.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 2
2\. Contributions to problem solving are made in a range of decision making processes and contexts.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Decision making matrices; Nominal group technique; Consensus; Majority vote.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 3
3\. Contributions to decision making are made on the basis of available data and are made objectively.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 4
4\. Contribution utilises verbal and non-verbal feedback to show interest and opinion, and to encourage contributions from others.
SPECIFIC OUTCOME 2
Contribute to group and/ or team functions.
ASSESSMENT CRITERIA
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 1
1\. Contribution supports the group in terms of complying with group/ team decisions, sharing responsibility for group/ team problems, and sharing credit for group/ team successes.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Support; Responsibility; Acceptability.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 2
2\. Contribution overcomes obstacles and ensures that the team function is consistent with team objectives and agreed rules for team member behavior.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Rules; Parameters; Guidelines; Clarification of issues.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 3
3\. Contributions made to the team's selection and use of techniques match the task requirements.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Brainstorming; Mind mapping; etc.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 4
4\. Contribution monitors own behavior in order to accommodate team dynamics.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Adhere to procedure; Language; Tone; Mannerisms
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 5
5\. Contribution ensures that delegated duties are carried out to team requirements.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Distributing meeting papers; Minute taking; Time keeping; Team presentations.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 6
6\. Contribution ensures that allocated tasks are carried out in a manner that reinforces the work of the team and contributes to the achievement of team objectives.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Obtaining resources; Evaluating ideas; Gathering data; Researching information.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 7
7\. Contribution presents outcomes and findings from allocated tasks in a manner that maximises their value to the team.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Relevance, Clarity and Timeliness

3\. All activities must comply with any policies, procedures and requirements of the organisations involved, the ethical codes of relevant professional bodies and any relevant legislative and/ or regulatory requirements.

PURPOSE OF THE UNIT STANDARD
This unit standard is intended:
 to provide fundamental knowledge of the areas covered?
 for those working in, or entering the workplace in the area of Business and Organisational Communication ?
 as additional knowledge for those wanting to understand the areas covered
People credited with this unit standard are able to:?
 Contribute to team problem solving?
 Contribute to group and/ or team function
The performance of all elements is to a standard that allows for further learning in this area.
LEARNING ASSUMED TO BE IN PLACE AND RECOGNITION OF PRIOR LEARNING
The learner should have the competence to communicate in English (or the applicable language) at least at NQF level 3.
Specific Outcomes and Assessment Criteria:
SPECIFIC OUTCOME 1
Contribute to team problem solving
ASSESSMENT CRITERIA
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 1
1\. Contributions made are relevant to, and focussed on, subject matter and group/ team objectives.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Ideas; Information; Opinions; Recommendations.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 2
2\. Contributions to problem solving are made in a range of decision making processes and contexts.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Decision making matrices; Nominal group technique; Consensus; Majority vote.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 3
3\. Contributions to decision making are made on the basis of available data and are made objectively.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 4
4\. Contribution utilises verbal and non-verbal feedback to show interest and opinion, and to encourage contributions from others.
SPECIFIC OUTCOME 2
Contribute to group and/ or team functions.
ASSESSMENT CRITERIA
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 1
1\. Contribution supports the group in terms of complying with group/ team decisions, sharing responsibility for group/ team problems, and sharing credit for group/ team successes.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Support; Responsibility; Acceptability.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 2
2\. Contribution overcomes obstacles and ensures that the team function is consistent with team objectives and agreed rules for team member behavior.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Rules; Parameters; Guidelines; Clarification of issues.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 3
3\. Contributions made to the team's selection and use of techniques match the task requirements.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Brainstorming; Mind mapping; etc.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 4
4\. Contribution monitors own behavior in order to accommodate team dynamics.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Adhere to procedure; Language; Tone; Mannerisms
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 5
5\. Contribution ensures that delegated duties are carried out to team requirements.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Distributing meeting papers; Minute taking; Time keeping; Team presentations.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 6
6\. Contribution ensures that allocated tasks are carried out in a manner that reinforces the work of the team and contributes to the achievement of team objectives.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Obtaining resources; Evaluating ideas; Gathering data; Researching information.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION 7
7\. Contribution presents outcomes and findings from allocated tasks in a manner that maximises their value to the team.
ASSESSMENT CRITERION RANGE
Relevance, Clarity and Timeliness
